readerCopy.body: Past work can open a door that would have been difficult to open from scratch. When the Sun sextiles the North Node, recognition and forward movement cooperate, allowing credibility already earned to support something newer through an introduction, recommendation, invitation, or first chance to lead in unfamiliar territory. The value is not simply being rewarded for staying the same. Old recognition becomes especially useful when it creates experience or access that belongs to the next direction.
